result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the page: one minor text truncation issue and one minor layout clipping issue in the horizontal scroll section.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, making it appear like a broken or incomplete label rather than intentional overflow.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis or limit the card width so the text truncates gracefully with '...' to signal to users that the name continues.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll row is visually clipped at the screen edge with no clear affordance (like a partial shadow or fade) to indicate horizontal scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient fade on the right edge of the scroll container to visually communicate that more items are available by scrolling horizontally.
